items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah. Professor Minetta told us that some of the fellows used to use in that part.

ctx.x: I never saw them until the 80 years. I wouldn't say they weren't playing, you know, but I never saw them until the 80 years. Because I get, somewhere or another I get confused. I was in some of those, yeah. But I did have, I had a crown that my mother had got me in the 20s, which was part Albert and part Bim. The bottom part was Bim with the top.
Oh yeah. Professor Minetta told us that some of the fellows used to use in that part. Yeah, my mother got it for me.

How was the tongue? The tongue was good, but one night I was working and it had a silver tube from the, right from where the valve begins coming down, the first half. Yeah. A whole silver tube in there. And all that ones had lost the tone. They just went down one night and I went to use it. And air was too hard, too many air with it. They just lost the tone. I brought it on Bimble between Dolphin and Bourbon. They had a violin maker there. And he was supposed to fix it and I didn't know if something went wrong.…
